period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Half-Yearly 2016 unaudited financial statements (clean digital pdftotext, some scattered character-level corruption typical of this bank's PDFs, but this particular filing's Balance Sheet and most P&L income/expense lines are directly legible). Plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used. Comparative column (31 Dec 2015) reproduces this dataset's existing FY2015 equity of 33557.96m exactly (TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY comparative = 33,557,964,916, also matching the Statement of Changes in Equity's own 'Balance on 01 January 2016' row). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2016 (this Half-Yearly filing's first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Jun 2016] [Jan-Jun 2015] [Apr-Jun 2016 discrete] [Apr-Jun 2015 discrete]). All four income lines (net interest, investment, commission, other operating) summed exactly to the printed 'Total operating income' of 8,507,925,678, which minus 'Total operating expenses' (2,653,273,137) reproduces the printed 'Profit before provision' (5,854,652,541) exactly; that figure minus 'Total provision' (2,526,259,456) reproduces 'Profit before taxes' (3,328,393,085) exactly; minus tax (1,300,000,000) reproduces 'Net Profit after taxation' (2,028,393,085) exactly, which also matches the Statement of Changes in Equity's own 'Net profit for the period' line. Net interest income (1,282,828,681) also equals this dataset's already-recorded 2016_Q1 solo NII (390.27m) plus this filing's own discrete Apr-Jun 2016 NII (892,557,864), a useful cross-check of quarter-to-quarter additivity. Interest income and interest paid on deposits/borrowings are marked unavailable: both rows are entirely consumed by garbled box-drawing artifacts in the source text with no recoverable digits, the same failure mode already documented for 2016_Q1. No NAV-per-share line is printed in this filing; nav_per_share is calculated from equity and paid-up capital (17,177,199,240 Taka, unchanged from Dec 2015 -- the first of several bonus-share capital increases in this history had not yet occurred as of this filing).
